curator_note: Location is still TBA and Gabbs is an unknown to me, so this is a bet on the promoter, not the name. Keep it on the radar until the address drops.
description: Late-night Certified Groovers party headlined by Gabbs, venue to be announced in DTLA.

artist_notes.name: Dubfire
artist_notes.note: Iranian-American techno veteran, half of Deep Dish and founder of the SCI+TEC label; deep, hypnotic, technical sets.

artist_notes.name: Truncate
artist_notes.note: David Flores — LA techno producer, co-founder of OBSERVE; raw, hypnotic, groove-driven, played Berghain and fabric.

artist_notes.name: NEKTER
artist_notes.note: LA techno DJ and WORK LA resident; hypnotic, texture-heavy sets.

curator_note: Dubfire and Truncate on one bill is a real techno night, and the Dubfire20 branding suggests an anniversary run. Venue is TBA, so watch for the reveal, but this is the one to grab tickets for early.
description: WORK's Dubfire20 night with Dubfire, Truncate and NEKTER; venue TBA in Los Angeles.

curator_note: No lineup posted yet, just EMX and the house/tech-house tag. It's a Los Globos Friday that's easy to reach from Silver Lake, so check it once names appear.
description: EMX's house and tech-house night at Los Globos in Silver Lake; lineup not yet announced.

artist_notes.name: Capes
artist_notes.note: LA underground house DJ/producer (Ray Barragan), half of club tularosa; emotionally-charged small-room sets.

curator_note: Midnight to 9am at $17 is a proper all-nighter, and Capes is the one local I'd trust to make the late hours worthwhile. Location is TBA, so it's a commitment, but the price is low.
description: Melt Collective all-night house and tech-house party running 11:59pm to 9am; venue TBA.

curator_note: Easy weekend flea for vintage and crate-digging, and it's free with free parking. The listing says it moved to Atwater this year, so confirm hours before going.
description: Weekly indie flea market of vintage, vinyl and handmade goods, now in Atwater Village.

artist_notes.name: Andy Oro
artist_notes.note: LA DJ, VPN Radio's Oro Hour host and Made to Move resident; eclectic underground/house.

artist_notes.name: agraybé
artist_notes.note: LA/Minnesota DJ in the Made to Move orbit; psychedelic, groove-forward house.

curator_note: An early 7pm rooftop start in DTLA with two Made to Move people, which fits the sunset-groove mood well. A low-key way to start a Saturday.
description: Rooftop house party at The Broken Shaker in DTLA with Andy Oro and agraybé.

curator_note: Blind Tiger's weeknight afterhours at The Lexington, free with an early RSVP and running to 5am. No lineup posted, so go for the format and the price.
description: Blind Tiger's late-night tech-house and minimal session at The Lexington, 11pm to 5am.

artist_notes.name: Vilena
artist_notes.note: LA DJ/producer playing groovy, driving techno with a progressive edge.

curator_note: A deep local underground bill with a Warclaw B2B Alessio set, at a cheap or free-RSVP price. It ends at 2am, so it's a good start before going elsewhere.
description: 2N1T3's Cyberangel Pt.2 techno and experimental night at an East 6th St space with five local acts.
